record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Let M be a monomial ideal generated by q monomials of degree p, and let W be the ideal generated by the first q square-free monomials of degree p in reverse lexicographic order, using a larger polynomial ring if needed. Find conditions on M that imply b_i^S(S/W) <= b_i^S(S/M) for every i >= 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = k[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ be a polynomial ring over a field $k$, equipped with the standard grading. For a finitely generated graded $S$-module $N$, let $b_i^S(N) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^S(N,k)$ denote the $i$-th total Betti number of $N$.

Fix positive integers $p$ and $q$. Let $M \subset S$ be a monomial ideal minimally generated by exactly $q$ monomials, each of degree $p$. Working in a polynomial ring $S' = k[x_1, \ldots, x_N]$ (with $N \ge n$ chosen large enough if necessary), let $W \subset S'$ be the ideal generated by the first $q$ squarefree monomials of degree $p$ in the reverse lexicographic order on the monomials of $S'$.

Determine conditions on $M$ (and on the number of variables) that guarantee the inequality
$$ b_i^{S'}(S'/W) \le b_i^S(S/M) \qquad \text{for every } i \ge 0. $$
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open-ended problem about identifying conditions under which a squarefree reverse-lex initial segment ideal provides a lower bound for the Betti numbers of a monomial ideal generated in a single degree. Related comparison problems (lex-plus-powers conjecture, extremal Betti numbers of squarefree strongly stable / lexsegment ideals) have been studied, but no source found resolves this particular open-ended question in full generality.

status_evidence.title: On the extremal Betti numbers of squarefree monomial ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Studies extremal Betti numbers of squarefree monomial ideals and squarefree lexsegment ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related comparison results exist but the open-ended characterization remains an active research direction.

status_evidence.title: Extremal Betti Numbers and Applications to Monomial Ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces extremal Betti numbers and gives applications to monomial ideals, including comparisons with lex-segment ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational comparison framework; does not settle the specific squarefree reverse-lex inequality in the stated generality.
